name: morph-gpu-fling-end-v1
about: fix-morph-gpu, rev 2 G check (lead ruling 2026-10-04): one first open per page load reached by a fling straight into the end, with no scroll rest before the push. With --inject fixes/morph-gpu/phone/rv2-flinglog.mjs the page jumps to 4.5 viewports above the end on load (outside rev 2's setup range); flings run until the end; the push past the end starts at once (no 'settled' wait), so rev 2's 300 ms scroll-rest setup may not have run; then a close.
